text.en:
23rd. AUGUST, 2017 No. S 69

COMPETITION ORDER, 2015 (S 112015) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section 1(1] and (2) of the Competition Order, 2015, the Minister in the Office of the Prime Minister and Minister of Finance 11, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 1st August 2017 as the date on which the provisions of that Order as set out in the Schedule hereto shall be deemed to have commenced -

SCHEDULE

PROVISIONS OF COMPETITION ORDER, 2015

PART I

PART I1 section 62 section 63

FIRST SCHEDULE SECOND SCHEDULE. Dated this 30th. day of Zulkaedah, 1438 Hijriah corresponding to the 23rd. day of August, 2017.

DATO PADUKA AWANG HAJI HAMZAH

BIN HAJI SULAIMAN Permanent Secretary, Office of the Prime Minister, Brunei Darussalam.
